name: Dumbbell pullover
notes: Single dumbbell held in both hands. Record the load of the dumbbell.

guide.setup: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell over the chest with both hands cupping the top end and elbows softly bent.
guide.execution: Lower the dumbbell back over the head until the lats are stretched, then pull it back over the chest.
guide.cues: Keep ribs down. Hold the elbow angle steady. Stop where the shoulders stay comfortable.
guide.mistakes: Arching the lower back; bending and straightening the elbows; going deeper than the shoulders allow; rushing the lowering phase.
